✨ claude-bridge | Java
🎯 Primary Use Case: Remote control and monitoring of Claude Code sessions from a mobile device without relying on cloud infrastructure.
✨ Key Features: • Full terminal mirroring on phone (xterm.js) • Support for multiple sessions and paired PCs • Push notifications for Claude Code hooks • Remote access via p2p tunnel (iroh) • Voice input for messages
📖 Summary: Claude Bridge allows users to mirror and control their Claude Code terminal sessions directly from an Android phone. It establishes a direct connection between the phone and the PC, either over a local network or via a p2p tunnel, eliminating the need for servers.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ MeshSense | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Monitoring and visualizing the health and status of Meshtastic mesh networks.
✨ Key Features: • Monitors Meshtastic network health • Maps and graphically displays network stats • Connects via Bluetooth or WiFi • Provides node information, signal reports, and trace routes • Supports headless usage via command-line flags and environment variables
📖 Summary: MeshSense is an open-source application written in TypeScript that monitors, maps, and graphically displays the vital statistics of Meshtastic mesh networks. It connects via Bluetooth or WiFi to provide insights into network health, including connected nodes, signal reports, and trace routes.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 PdfDing | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Self-hosted management, viewing, and editing of PDF documents across multiple devices.
✨ Key Features: • Browser-based PDF viewing with position memory • Workspaces, collections, multi-level tagging, starring, and archiving • PDF editing (text, highlighting, drawings) • Signature addition • Export of highlights and comments
📖 Summary: PdfDing is a self-hosted PDF management, viewing, and editing solution designed for seamless cross-device access. It offers features like workspaces, tagging, highlighting, and SSO, all accessible through a clean, intuitive web interface.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 RS-Key | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide open-source, customizable firmware for the Raspberry Pi RP2350 to function as a multi-protocol security key for authentication and cryptographic operations, primarily for development, research, and controlled experiments.
✨ Key Features: • FIDO2 / WebAuthn / U2F support (passkeys, 2FA, ssh ed25519-sk)
📖 Summary: RS-Key is an open-source, Rust-based firmware for the Raspberry Pi RP2350, transforming it into a versatile security key. It supports FIDO2, OpenPGP, PIV, and OATH protocols, enabling secure authentication and cryptographic operations. The project is experimental and intended for development and research, emphasizing its limitations and the need for careful threat modeling.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 DracoLure | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To act as a deceptive security honeypot that lures and analyzes malicious network traffic, identifying and blocking threats in real-time.
✨ Key Features: • Polyglot deception honeypot • Real-time detection and threat scoring • Automated quarantine and blocking of hostile sources • Serves believable bait (fake corporate portal, /.env, wp-login, etc.) • URL-decode normalization for payload analysis
📖 Summary: DracoLure is a polyglot deception honeypot designed to lure, detect, score, and quarantine malicious attackers in real-time. It serves believable bait to keep attackers engaged while analyzing their probes against a signature library, assigning threat scores, and automatically blocking hostile sources.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 RadioGuessr | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: A fun and educational web game for users to test their geography knowledge and explore global radio stations.
✨ Key Features: • Global Radio Exploration via Radio Browser API • Interactive 3D Globe powered by globe.gl • Multiple Visual Themes for the globe • Progressive Rounds with Score Tracking • Hints System (Language, City/State, Region)
📖 Summary: RadioGuessr is a web-based game inspired by GeoGuessr, where players listen to live radio streams from around the world and guess their origin location on an interactive 3D globe. It utilizes the Radio Browser API for streams and globe.gl for visualization, offering features like hints, rerolls, and session history.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
